topic: a tiny immediate-mode UI library in ANSI C that turns UI code re-run every frame plus input into rectangle and text draw commands
audience: a C developer new to immediate-mode UI
analogy: a short-order restaurant kitchen that forgets everything each loop and rebuilds the whole order from your shouts, then hands simple cook tickets for rectangles and text to whoever does the drawing
why: story with a kitchen analogy fits because the core flow is one frame's journey from input to draw commands, and overview depth fits a 1100-line tool where the big idea is the point
